CORE.text: Set up pages, readings and alerts with the mobile app. The round gauge keeps running on your dash without the phone.

LAYOUTS.text: Show a single number, a trend or two readings side by side.

ANDROID.text: Manage vehicles, gauges and settings in one place. The App reconnects to read your saved setup and can install signed development firmware over private Wi-Fi.

READINGS.text: On the modified Jeep, RPM matched the dash and engine readings ran alongside transmission temperature and gear. Independent loss and return of each adapter were checked.

UPDATES.text: Indoor Wi-Fi update and interruption checks retained the saved setup.

PLATFORMS.text: Planned work includes more vehicle profiles and setup over USB in a browser.

ACTIONS.text: Air up and Winch use timed raised idle with a countdown and direct Stop. Vehicle controls are being tested privately on Luke’s Jeep.

airUp.text: A four-tire timer estimated from a measured fill.

winch.text: A separate timed preset for recovery.

absTcs.text: Private testing while controller restoration is validated.

inputProvenance.reason: Reviewed CORE and LAYOUTS against the current feature index and display contract. Dot removal, the connection footer and brightness scheduling preserve the published setup, independent gauge operation and reading layouts. The feature-index additions do not change public access to virtual gauges, subscriptions or vehicle controls. The OLED offer still includes its preinstalled software major and remains inquiry-only. The separately priced Vgate is optional on both gauge offers. The foreground location retry for sunset brightness changes setup error handling and leaves the published layout claim unchanged. Mobile companion branding now reflects Android availability and the owner-prioritized iPhone follow-up for essential setup. USB configuration and broader vehicle profiles remain planned. PR #160 documents a board-specific startup decoration hook. The hook runs during boot and preserves the published reading layouts.
